about: Allcargo Global Ltd is the international supply chain arm of the Mumbai-based Allcargo Group, promoted by Shashi Kiran Shetty. It is an asset-light, digital-first NVOCC offering LCL consolidation, neutral FCL and neutral air freight globally under the ECU Worldwide brand, and is the world's largest LCL consolidator with a ~14-15% global share. The company was demerged from Allcargo Logistics Ltd under an NCLT-approve
